bio: Research Overview Research Background Education Publications Contact Us Dr. Pui Lee is a pediatric rheumatologist with research interests in autoinflammatory diseases and myeloid cell biology. His lab studies the role of immunometabolism in the development and differentiation of monocytes, a type of white blood cells that incites inflammation, with the goal of identifying treatment targets for inflammatory diseases. In addition, Dr. Lee is interested in the mechanism of immune activation in autoinflammatory diseases. He has ongoing projects focused on macrophage activation syndrome and a rare disease called deficiency of adenosine deaminase 2 (DADA2).
